caption: The drawing consists of several distinct elements arranged vertically on a tan, textured background with a vignette effect at the edges. At the top, there is a stylized cross in a mustard yellow color with red outlines and accents inside, as well as blue ornamental shapes and yellow radiating lines suggesting light. Below the cross, there is a bow-like form with four elongated loops featuring turquoise blue outlines and filled with mustard yellow, red, and blue dotted patterns, connected at the center by a circular motif. On either side of the bow, there are shapes resembling stylized wings, depicted in solid mustard yellow with red tips. Below the bow and wings, there is a large ornate circular design predominantly featuring turquoise blue, mustard yellow, and red. The circle is outlined in red and blue, and inside it is a symmetrical mandala-like pattern consisting of radiating triangular shapes, curved lines, and petal motifs in the three main colors. The overall arrangement presents the cross at the top, bow and wings in the middle, and the circular pattern at the bottom, all centered vertically and horizontally.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
